It does not prove the open radius bound, H_q values, A_P<=P+m-2 (already contradicted by the stated examples), or A_(T_small+1)<=T_small+m-2. The H_q sentence is not an exact characterization.","proof_or_counterexample":"Fix n=m+r>=3 and a labeled trajectory of W. Compare unlabeled projections before and after each generator, deleting the current slot of a fixed label z. L (resp. R) replaces the length-(n-1) projection by a nontrivial cyclic shift of itself unless z is at index 0 (resp. n-1). For m>=2 the surviving tokens are not all equal, so a cyclic shift changes the linear vector. Thus a rotation is invisible for z iff it is one of the boundary events in I_z, including when other zeros are adjacent: only the zero that actually crosses is invisible. X is invisible iff the two swapped symbols are equal after deleting z, iff both are zeros, or one is z and the other is positive. Those are exactly the global two-zero swaps S and the z-positive swaps inside I_z; the two sets are disjoint, and X of two positives or of another zero with a positive is visible for z. Hence every step is invisible for z precisely on S union I_z, so projection_length_z(W)=ell-S-I_z for every z and every word, not only sorting words. Therefore min_z projection_length_z=ell-S-max_z I_z. Since I_z are nonnegative integers, max I_z>=ceil((sum I_z)/r), so the min is <=ell-S-ceil(Z/r); that corollary is strict unless the I_z differ by at most 1. A sorting word certifies H_q(u,j)<=ell only if the zero achieving the min (or some zero with ell-S-I_z<=q) ends at that admissible j>=m. It does not compute the minimum, so 'exactly when' is false.","pitfalls":"Do not add an X of z with another zero to I_z; it is already in S, and double subtraction breaks the identity. Do not treat labeled zeros as distinct in the projection: that would make two-zero X visible and falsify the formula. Boundary events are only L at index 0 and R at the last index, not every move of a zero onto an endpoint. Adjacent zeros and label swaps change later I_z only through the carried label, not through the slot identity. Change-count is not projected geodesic length; cancellations in the projected generators are still counted, so the identity cannot lower-bound H_q. S is independent of z but I_z is not, and the zero of maximum I_z need not be the zero with the desired terminal j. The ceil bound can exceed q while the exact min still witnesses q. Using the conjecture to estimate S or I_z and then deduce the conjecture is circular. The stated (m,r,v) pairs kill A_P<=P+m-2 if their A_q numbers are independently verified; they are not consequences of this lemma. m=2,r=1 is covered by the same case split and is not a counterexample.","stronger_useful_lemma":"Certificate lemma, non-circular: for an explicitly constructed sorting word, track the r labels, compute S and every I_z, and if some z ends at j>=m with ell-S-I_z<=q then H_q(u,j)<=ell and hence A_q(u)<=ell. No radius conjecture is used. Arithmetic sufficient condition for the proposed lifting budget: a sorting word of length ell<=T_small+m-2 whose best admissible zero satisfies S+I_z>=ell-(T_small+1) is an A_(T_small+1) witness of length <=T_small+m-2. At the extreme ell=T_small+m-2 this is exactly S+max I_z>=m-3. For the m=8,r=9 split, T=84 and m-3=5; (q=78,B=83) is the stronger actual-radius step from 77, while (q=79,B=84) is the conjecture-facing step from the unproved inductive budget 78.
